author: Many authors, including David, Asaph, the sons of Korah, Solomon and Moses
authorNote: Many psalms carry titles naming an author; scholars debate how old these titles are.
overview: The Psalms are 150 songs and prayers used in worship by Israel and later by Christians. They cover every human emotion: praise, thanks, joy, grief, anger, fear and confession. Many point to God's king and are read by the New Testament as pointing to Jesus.
storyPlace: The Bible's prayer book, sung in Jewish and Christian worship to this day.
